registers.label: Spare
lines: The angel comes to a girl in Nazareth.
Greetings, favored one; the Lord is with you.
You will bear a son, and call him Jesus.
How can this be?
Nothing will be impossible with God.
Let it be with me according to your word.
A body you have prepared; he comes to do your will.
The Word is made flesh among us. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Into the middle of Lent breaks a word of light: the angel Gabriel stands in a small room before a young woman.
Let it be with us according to your word.
Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God, and you will bear a son and name him Jesus.
Let it be with us according to your word.
The Most High will overshadow her, and the holy child will be called the Son of God.
Let it be with us according to your word.
This is the sign Isaiah saw: a virgin shall conceive, and they shall call him Immanuel, God with us.
Let it be with us according to your word.
So with Mary we open our hands and say yes to the God who comes to dwell.
Let it be with us according to your word. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The angel comes to Mary with startling news.
Let it be.
You will bear a son and call him Jesus.
Let it be.
Nothing is impossible with God.
Let it be.
Come, let us welcome Immanuel, God with us.
Let it be with us according to your word. Amen.
